User: The size of the sandwich is a very hearty sandwich. If I eat one sandwich, I won't need to eat another one. Also, the ability to add mustard to the sandwich. I like mustard on my hamburgers, so it makes it better. And if you get the combo, the burger pairs well with the fries, and a small order of spicy chicken nuggets won't hurt either.
Agent: Okay, I understand. On the flip side, what are the top two or three things that would make the Wendy's Classic Triple "bad" for you? For example, if it were soggy, dry, cold, under-salted, too greasy, or stale?
